none: PAS LANCUM-58D574: copper alloy Roman coin
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ is [CRISPI]NA AVG IMP CO[MMODI AVG]

Copper alloy Roman sestertius of Crispina dating to the period AD 180 to 183 (Reece Period 9). Cf RIC 3 (Commodus) 672). Reverse depicts Salus seated left. The diameter is 28mm and the weight is 22.42g. Obverse inscription is [CRISPI]NA AVG IMP CO[MMODI AVG] and the reverse inscription was [SALVS S C]. The unusual shape of the flan indicates that there may possibly have been an attempt to clip this coin
